page.content:
Asgardian god of thunder and Avenger.

How Thor connects

  • Faction: Avengers — Thor fights with the Avengers.
  • Location: Asgard — Thor is prince of Asgard.
  • Character: Chris Hemsworth — Chris Hemsworth portrayed Thor (MCU).
  • Character: Loki — Loki and Thor are rival brothers.
  • Topic: Actors who have played — Portrayals of Thor sit under this character.

What is Thor?

Thor is the Asgardian prince who wields storm power, protects Midgard with the Avengers, and is bound to Loki and Asgard.

Key threads lead to Avengers, Asgard, Chris Hemsworth, Loki and Actors who have played.
